name: @spark/desktop
description: Spark 桌面壳（阶段五工单 5.1，ADR D14 sidecar 模式）：拉起 server sidecar + 加载 Web UI
author: Wanfeng1028

scripts.build:server: esbuild ../../apps/server/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=build/server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: pnpm build:server && pnpm --filter @spark/web build && pnpm build:main
